name: Claire · gentle American
description: An adult woman with a cultivated American English accent, gently articulated consonants, a warm medium-low pitch, and a soft, relaxed delivery. Calm, understated, and reassuring. Read as a patient tutor speaking to one adult listener, with natural pauses and subtle expression. Clear full voice, without whispering, exaggerated breathiness, or an announcer's cadence.

name: Grace · warm American
description: A mature adult woman speaking clear standard American English. Warm, mellow alto voice, soft spoken but fully audible, with a friendly conversational rhythm and gentle natural inflection. An attentive tutor explaining an interesting idea calmly to one person. Unhurried and articulate, without theatrical delivery or whispering.

name: Helen · refined American
description: An adult woman with a refined, lightly New England American English accent. Smooth medium-pitched voice, precise diction, and quiet warmth. Soft spoken, composed and thoughtful, with natural sentence emphasis and relaxed pauses. Conversational educational narration, not a newsreader, not breathy or whispered.
